title: Toyota / Lexus LED 頭燈與尾燈：從日本採購前要確認什麼？
description: Toyota / Lexus LED 頭燈與尾燈採購不能只看外觀。左右側、完整 OEM 品號、燈型、ADAS 規格、固定腳與鏡片狀態都應在日本採購前確認。
content:
Toyota / Lexus LED 頭燈、尾燈是台灣維修廠從日本尋找中古或原廠件時常見的需求，但也是很容易因版本差異而買錯的零件。
先確認完整 OEM 品號與左右側同一車型可能因年式、等級、市場規格、LED 版本、AFS／ADB 等功能而有不同品號。左／右側也必須明確。
中古燈具要看實物證據鏡片刮傷、黃化、裂痕、進水痕跡、固定腳、接頭與背殼狀態都應透過實物照片確認。只有商品標題不足以判斷。
有 ADAS／控制功能時更要核對部分燈具與車身控制、AFS、ADB 或其他電子控制相關。外觀相似不等於電氣規格完全相同。
JPNentry 的做法我們先核對 OEM 品號／VIN 與左右側，再確認日本當下真實可採購來源、實物狀態、價格與日本國內運費。沒有證據就不說有貨。
先查 1 顆燈即可請傳 OEM 品號；或 VIN／車身號碼 + 左右側 + 照片 + 數量。
Quick Request: https://form.jotform.com/262544250551048

title: Toyota / Lexus 雷達・PCS・ADAS 感知器：日本調達前的適配確認
description: 雷達、PCS 與 ADAS 感知器不是外觀相同就能直接替換。完整 OEM 品號、VIN、車型等級、安裝位置與校正需求都應在採購前確認。
content:
Toyota / Lexus 的雷達、PCS、ADAS 感知器與相關電子零件，常因事故修復、缺料或新品價格較高而需要從日本尋找。
外觀看起來一樣，仍可能不相容感知器可能因年式、改款、車型等級、軟體／硬體版本與市場規格而不同。完整 OEM 品號通常是第一個確認點。
沒有品號時要用 VIN／車身號碼VIN／chassis、安裝位置、車型等級與零件照片可協助建立較可靠的適配依據。
校正與初始化不是零件本身的保證範圍即使硬體品號正確，部分 ADAS 元件仍可能需要車輛端校正、初始化或其他作業。採購前應由維修端確認後續施工條件。
日本端只報有證據的貨源JPNentry 會確認實際 listing、OEM 品號、狀態、賣家與當下庫存證據，再決定是否能正式報價。
現在有一顆雷達或 PCS 要找？傳完整 OEM 品號；沒有品號則傳 VIN／車身號碼 + 零件照片 + 數量。

title: ECU / Body ECU / 控制模組從日本採購：品號、版本與風險確認
description: ECU、Body ECU、顯示器與控制模組採購前要確認完整 OEM 品號、版本、VIN 適配與可能的編碼／初始化需求。日本中古件尤其需要證據型採購。
content:
ECU、Body ECU、空調控制模組、顯示器與其他電子模組，是日本中古原廠件中最需要避免『看起來一樣就買』的類別之一。
完整 OEM 品號優先電子模組常有非常接近但功能不同的版本。完整品號、尾碼與標籤照片都應確認。
VIN 與車型等級仍然重要即使品號相近，也可能因年式、等級、市場版本或配備差異而不適用。沒有完整品號時，VIN／chassis 與車輛資訊不可省略。
編碼、初始化、學習值要由維修端確認中古電子模組可能涉及 coding、registration、initialization、immobilizer 或其他車輛端程序。這些施工條件必須在採購前由買方維修端確認。
賣家與狀態證據日本端應確認實物標籤、品號、外觀、拆車來源資訊與當下 listing。不能只依賴搜尋結果頁面或模糊標題。

有一顆 ECU／模組要查？傳 OEM 品號 + 標籤照片；若無品號，傳 VIN／車身號碼 + 零件照片 + 數量。

The positioning is deliberately narrow: JPNentry acts as a backup Japan-side sourcing route for exact OEM references, hard-to-find items, shortages, and timing-sensitive requirements. Fitment and export conditions are checked before quote.
Multilingual cross-border executionCurrent commercial workflows include English, Brazilian Portuguese, and Traditional Chinese buyer communication paths.
Brazil workflows are designed around verified public business contact evidence and a current Japan-sourcing demand signal. Taiwan workflows prioritize official business channels and exact OEM/VIN-based requests. Generic mass outreach is not treated as proof of demand.
What has already been built operationallyJPNentry now operates dedicated systems for product sourcing, Japanese TCG and collectibles, Japanese OEM auto parts, new Toyota vehicles, industrial and hard-to-find Japanese components, and Japan market-entry / sales execution.
The operating stack includes buyer qualification, RFQ capture, exact-item sourcing records, supplier verification gates, quote controls, margin checks, payment matching, procurement gates, compliance/logistics checks, suppression controls, event logs, and repeat-order tracking.
For direct sourcing work, live Stripe checkout paths are already available for Japan Quick Search (USD 49), Priority Sourcing (USD 149), and Sourcing Project Start (USD 300), followed by a structured paid intake.

How JPNentry treats proofWe do not use fictional testimonials, invented customer logos, fake stock claims, assumed supplier allocation, fabricated savings, or guaranteed meetings and sales.
A prospect is not a client. A quote is not revenue. A supplier listing is not confirmed stock. A payment screenshot is not matched funds. A sourcing fee is not authorization to purchase goods.

title: Buyer Protection at JPNentry: Quote, Approval, Payment and Export
description: JPNentry’s transaction process is built around a simple principle: important commercial facts should be explicit before money moves or procurement begins. Clear scope before priceA quote is tied to a specific requirement. We avoid vague package pricing when the underlying vehicle, quantity, destination, freight basis, or sourcing route has not yet been verified. Transparent cost structureWhere relevant to the transaction, a quotation can distinguish procurement cost, domestic Japan fees,...
content:
JPNentry’s transaction process is built around a simple principle: important commercial facts should be explicit before money moves or procurement begins.
Clear scope before priceA quote is tied to a specific requirement. We avoid vague package pricing when the underlying vehicle, quantity, destination, freight basis, or sourcing route has not yet been verified.
Transparent cost structureWhere relevant to the transaction, a quotation can distinguish procurement cost, domestic Japan fees, export and handling charges, freight, insurance, payment costs, risk allowances, and JPNentry’s commercial margin. The exact structure depends on the agreed scope and shipping basis.
Written approvalProcurement should not begin merely because a conversation sounds positive. JPNentry requires an explicit commercial approval for the exact transaction basis before moving to procurement.
Matched paymentFunds are treated as received only after they are matched to the correct transaction. A screenshot or transfer notice by itself is not sufficient evidence that the required funds have settled and matched.
No silent substitutionsIf the originally approved vehicle or specification changes, the change must be surfaced to the buyer. A different grade, specification, colour, unit, or commercial basis is not silently substituted.
Evidence-backed status updatesWe distinguish between planned, quoted, approved, paid, secured, and shipped. These are separate stages. A vehicle is not described as secured or shipped until the corresponding evidence exists.
Independent sourcing, not manufacturer representationJPNentry operates independently and does not claim manufacturer affiliation, official Toyota allocation, or exclusive rights. This protects both buyer and seller from misleading assumptions about the transaction.
For a first transaction, the simplest route is one real requirement, one evidence-backed sourcing route, one approved quotation, and one clearly tracked order. Trust should come from a process that can be checked, not from large promises.

title: OEM Part Number + VIN: Reduce Wrong-Part Risk Before Buying from Japan
description: For Toyota and Lexus OEM parts, exact part number, VIN/chassis, position, grade and quantity can dramatically reduce wrong-part sourcing risk.
content:
For OEM parts, the fastest sourcing request is usually not 'I need a headlight' — it is the exact OEM number or enough vehicle data to verify fitment.
Best information to send
* Exact OEM part number if available
* VIN or chassis/frame number
* Vehicle model, year and grade
* Left/right/front/rear position where relevant
* Photo of the current part or label
* Quantity and destination
Why it matters
Small specification differences can create expensive mistakes. JPNentry treats fitment as something to verify, not assume.
